text:
kai: heads-up: EU canary for user-session-service started promotion but deploy-bot flagged HPA churn and pod restarts during scale-up

deploy-bot: [promote] EU canary paused at 10%
deploy-bot: reason: post-upgrade HPA target mismatch -> rapid scale loop detected
deploy-bot: sample logs:
```
kubectl describe hpa user-session-service -n prod-eu
Events:
  Type    Reason             Age   From                       Message
  ----    ------             ----  ----                       -------
  Normal  SuccessfulRescale  1m    horizontal-pod-autoscaler  New size: 12; reason: TargetAverageUtilization too low
  Warning FailedGetMetrics   40s   metrics-server              unable to get metrics for resource cpu: metrics API not available
```

stella: that metrics-server error is spiking in EU region intermittently this morning. could be rate limit on metrics API after the infra PR changed scrape interval

kai: this release changed default values: `values.yaml` bumped HPA targetCPU to 40 and minReplicas from 2->5 to handle warmup. maybe too aggressive for canary footprint

product: any customer-facing impact?

stella: no errors surfaced to customers yet, but we saw 500s during the scale flapping window in preprod around 03:12 UTC. low risk but noisy and could cause broader instability if promoted globally

kai: options: 1) abort and rollback to previous chart revision (1.7.2) 2) pin values for EU canary to conservative HPA settings and re-promote 3) keep paused and escalate infra to fix metrics-server

ops: infra is already looking at metrics-server but timeline unclear (30-90m).

stella: I'd prefer pinning values for canary to reduce blast radius. we can add values override in promotion: `--set hpa.minReplicas=2 --set hpa.targetCPU=60` and note as tech debt in release notes

kai: agree. pin + short monitor window. if healthy -> schedule global promote. if flapping continues -> rollback to 1.7.2

deploy-bot: promotion paused -> applying override once PR merged with pinned values will resume auto-promotion

kai: who will push the PR? stella?

stella: i'll open PR now with title: "promote(user-session): pin EU canary HPA values to avoid metrics churn" and include the helm promote command in the description:
```
helm upgrade --install user-session ./charts/user-session --version 1.8.0 -f values-eu.yaml --set hpa.minReplicas=2 --set hpa.targetCPU=60 --wait
```

stella: PR opened: github.com/redwood/release/pulls/2893 (assigning @kai for review)

kai: reviewing now. quick check: any other chart hooks? preupgrade hook calls a migration job but it's guarded by `if .Values.migrations.enabled` and remains false in EU values -> safe

deploy-bot: promotion-resume scheduled upon merge of PR 2893

product: draft release-note blurb? needs short explainer + customer impact + action items

kai: draft: "user-session 1.8.0: EU canary promoted with temporary HPA value override (minReplicas=2, targetCPU=60) due to transient metrics-server instability causing HPA rescaling events during canary. No customer action required. Platform will revert to chart defaults after metrics stability confirmed and during the next maintenance window."

stella: tests running, merging in 2m
stella: merged PR 2893 -> deploy-bot acknowledged

deploy-bot: EU canary promotion resumed; 2/2 pods ready -> 4/4 -> stabilizing; healthchecks passing

kai: monitoring 15m. if 99p latency or error rate spikes -> manual hold and rollback

ops: metrics-server alerts cleared after reducing scrape concurrency. infra will backfill a postmortem in infra/monitoring#78

deploy-bot: EU canary promotion succeeded; auto-promote to global scheduled in 20m

kai: thanks all. after global promote we'll post a short note in release notes and #all-hands summary. ops to track infra/monitoring#78 for root cause and revert plan for HPA defaults

product: tagging release note and linking PR 2893 and issue infra/monitoring#78 in changelog

stella: done. closing thread. :white_check_mark:"
